description: This file defines inline functions for handling mixed data types within tensors, specifically on CPU. It includes functions to determine tensor scalar types, check for mixed data types, and enforce type constraints in tensor operations within the at::native namespace.

methods.name: ScalarType first_type()
methods.description: Returns ScalarType::Undefined or the scalar type of a tensor if defined; used to identify the type of tensor arguments.

methods.name: first_type (variadic)
methods.description: Recursive template to determine the first tensor argument with a defined scalar type.

methods.name: bool is_mixed_type(const Tensor & input,const Args &...parameters)
methods.description: Checks whether the input tensor's type differs from the types of additional parameters, indicating a mixed data type scenario.

methods.name: void check_mixed_data_type(const Tensor & input)
methods.description: Enforces that all tensors involved in an operation share compatible data types, suitable for CPU tensors with floating point types.

methods.name: ScalarType param_scalar_type(const Tensor & t,bool is_mixed_type)
methods.description: Determines the scalar type of a tensor, returning Float if the type is part of a mixed type scenario; otherwise, returns the tensor's own scalar type.

methods.name: void check_mixed_data_type(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & parameter,const Args &...parameters)
